name: plex-mcp
description: Comprehensive FastMCP 3.4+ server for Plex Media Server management — 20+ portmanteau tools for media, libraries, sessions, playlists, users, collections, search, reporting, RAG, quality, performance, enrichment, integration, and audio management.

plex_url.title: Plex Server URL
plex_url.description: URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g., http://localhost:32400)

plex_token.title: Plex Authentication Token
plex_token.description: Your Plex authentication token from https://plex.tv/pms/servers

tools.name: plex_library
tools.description: Plex library management — list, create, scan, refresh, stats, cleanup, path management, optimize, empty trash, reorder, configure.

tools.name: plex_media
tools.description: Plex media browsing and CRUD — browse, search, get, get_recent, get_recommended, similar, stream_info, refresh, update, delete.

tools.name: plex_search
tools.description: Advanced Plex search — global, advanced, people, studios, suggest, saved filters across all content types.

tools.name: plex_streaming
tools.description: Real-time streaming monitoring and control — sessions, clients, transcode, bandwidth, direct play, remote, LAN, kill session.

tools.name: plex_server
tools.description: Plex server management — status, info, health, logs, restart, maintenance, scheduled tasks, transcode queue, updates.

tools.name: plex_user
tools.description: Plex user management — list, get, create, update, delete, policy, password, sessions, activity, devices.

tools.name: plex_playlist
tools.description: Plex playlist management — list, get, create, update, delete, add_items, remove_items, reorder, share.

tools.name: plex_collections
tools.description: Plex collection management — list, get, create, update, delete, add_items, remove_items.

tools.name: plex_metadata
tools.description: Plex item metadata management — get, update, refresh, identify, images, backdrops, providers, lock, unlock, fetch.

tools.name: plex_organization
tools.description: Plex library organization — analyze, deduplicate, fix_matching, bulk_tag, naming_audit.

tools.name: plex_performance
tools.description: Plex performance and server status — get_server_status, get_server_health, get_system_stats, get_bandwidth, get_libraries.

tools.name: plex_quality
tools.description: Plex quality profile management — get_profiles, set_quality, get_optimized_versions, compare_profiles.

tools.name: plex_reporting
tools.description: Plex library reporting — stats, popular, recent, genres, resolution, codec, user_activity, export.

tools.name: plex_rag
tools.description: Semantic RAG search over Plex metadata — sync, search, status, reindex, purge using LanceDB + FastEmbed.

tools.name: plex_help
tools.description: PlexMCP help and discovery — discover, tool_help, status, tips, quickstart, faq.

tools.name: plex_integration
tools.description: Cross-platform integration — export_plex, import_plex, sync_watchstate, backup, restore.

tools.name: plex_media_enrichment
tools.description: External metadata enrichment — tmdb, wikipedia, musicbrainz, omdb, tvdb, batch enrichment.

tools.name: plex_audio_mgr
tools.description: Plex audio management — status, libraries, codecs, transcode, quality, optimize.

tools.name: plex_ffmpeg_mgr
tools.description: Plex FFmpeg config and hardware acceleration — profiles, performance, detect_hw, path, test, benchmarks.

tools.name: arr_stack
tools.description: *Arr service integration — health, queue, history, radarr, sonarr, lidarr status across the media stack.
